source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Start direct-acting antiviral treatment after every HCV exposure before baseline testing because immediate prophylaxis is standard.","B":"Obtain baseline and indicated follow-up HCV testing because occupational HCV postexposure prophylaxis is not recommended.","C":"Give hepatitis C immune globulin and omit follow-up testing if the needlestick site was washed promptly after the exposure.","D":"Give an HCV vaccine series and check post-vaccination immunity rather than arranging baseline and follow-up laboratory testing."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC recommends baseline testing and indicated follow-up testing after occupational HCV exposure. HCV postexposure prophylaxis is not recommended, and no HCV vaccine is available.
source_row.source_detail: Test the HCP > Baseline Testing; HCV PEP Not Recommended; Testing 3–6 weeks after exposure; Testing 4–6 months after exposure.
